description: Ablation matrix for graph-vector-code fusion. Each arm sets the config gates listed and is run against the production-gate corpus. The eval harness records Recall@{1,5,10}, MRR, nDCG, and answer-citation accuracy per arm, plus p95 latency. Promotion to default requires the full-fusion arm to beat the baseline arm on the agreed gates while staying within the latency budget.

promotion_gate.note: Provisional thresholds; the implementation PR may replace with an explicit precision/recall tradeoff + non-regression bound after measuring the live baseline.

arms.name: baseline
arms.description: Fusion off — existing lexical/semantic/graph memory recall.

arms.name: structural_graph_only
arms.description: Code graph projection edges with structural trust, no code vectors, no learned utility.

arms.name: structural_graph_plus_code_vectors
arms.description: Structural graph + code vector recall, no learned utility.

arms.name: fusion_without_learned_utility
arms.description: Full graph-vector fusion rerank but utility scoring disabled.

arms.name: learned_utility_replay_only
arms.description: Replay recorded utility feedback, no structural code bias (code structural_factor = 1.0).

arms.name: utility_cap_default
arms.description: Full fusion with default utility cap [-0.5, 2.0].

arms.name: utility_cap_rebalanced
arms.description: Full fusion with rebalanced utility cap [-0.25, 1.0] for sparse feedback.

arms.name: code_structural_factor_disabled
arms.description: Full fusion but code structural_factor forced to 1.0 (ablate cold-start code bias).

arms.name: full_fusion
arms.description: All signals on — structural graph + code vectors + learned utility + fusion rerank.
